Hey there @compatech, @bouwew, @brefra, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`plugwise`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L398) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

Hi all, I'm a noob in Python, but have been looking at the specific code for this. Looks like it should be appended to the sensor.py (https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/homeassistant/components/plugwise/sensor.py). However I'm not sure where the state_class should be added. Somewhere near line 296?

If there is any pointers to where I could start; much appreciated. Would love to start contributing.

We are working on #55980 which includes solving this issue, I guess everyone is busy with hacktoberfest but hopefully we can get traction on that (set of) PRs soon so we are on-par with the latest library. If you already want this functionality feel free to (temporarily) use the `plugwise-beta` custom-component (see github.com/plugwise)

review_comments: This integration should really migrate to `SensorEntityDescription` classes.

I actually have a question about this suggestion. Before the `SensorEntityDescription` became available, @CoMPaTech and I thought it would be a good idea to move this descriptive part into the backend. That would make the Core-code less cluttered we were thinking. Please see https://github.com/plugwise/python-plugwise/blob/main/plugwise/constants.py line 528 and down. And the resulting Core-code: https://github.com/plugwise/plugwise-beta/tree/master/custom_components/plugwise

What is your opinion about this implementation? Is it suitable for integration into Core, via #55980?

We prefer to have the description in the Home Assistant Core, as it explicitly defines the connection of entities between the core and library. Also, Home Assistant will know what it (and how it) will expose things.

Using EntityDescription is therefore preferred. I would suggest not putting that into this PR but at a later stage.
We don't allow libraries to set the entity interface directly without validation.
@balloob @frenck @MartinHjelmare Thanks for your feedback! This will help us shape the contents of #55980
